picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest node in DOE's new Genesis Mission, the week's dominant story tying federal AI investment to national-lab science at scale.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry brings the Genesis Mission's reach to 15+ federal agencies under a whole-of-government executive order, signaling this is a durable national AI-for-science policy shift, not a one-off DOE grant round.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's AGIS program to build generative AI foundation models purpose-built for scientific discovery is a distinct, ambitious research bet outside the U.S. Genesis Mission wave, with the week's highest scientific-impact score.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330M raise at a £2B valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as CSO, shows AI-driven materials discovery attracting serious private capital alongside the public funding surge elsewhere this week.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: USC's national team developing new AI turbulence-prediction models under Genesis Mission targets fundamental physics with cross-cutting applications in energy and transportation.
picks.title: USC leads national AI research project to accelerate scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: Florida State's four Genesis Mission projects tackle fusion-energy superconductors and quantum error correction, pairing AI methods with hard science problems central to future energy infrastructure.
picks.title: Florida State University secures Department of Energy Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: Iowa State's eight Genesis Mission roles illustrate how deeply the DOE initiative is drawing in land-grant research universities as core partners, not just elite labs.
picks.title: Several Iowa State research projects selected for U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's AI-driven approach to recovering critical metals from spent lithium-ion batteries links national-lab science directly to supply-chain and clean-energy priorities.
picks.title: SLAC to lead Genesis Mission AI project to recover critical metals from lithium-ion battery waste

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83M data-infrastructure investment is a distinct, substantial funding commitment underpinning AI-ready research data nationwide, complementing but separate from the Genesis Mission awards.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's role leading six projects and partnering on 17 more shows the depth of national-lab cross-collaboration the Genesis Mission is catalyzing across the DOE complex.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others
